text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sudden auth-failure & 429 surge on /v1/embeddings from small set of proxies (sig: header-hash=0x8f3a). Throttling autoslice kicked in. detections: credential-noise, high fanout.

jessica: I'm on it. seeing ~11k failed auth attempts/min from ~240 IPs clustered in ASNs. latency up 20% for some EU tenants but overall success rate still >95%.

sam: paging in — oncall. what's the customer impact?

jessica: customer impact: a handful of mid-market customers reporting errors and elevated latencies on embedding endpoints. async batch jobs timing out. realtime chat endpoints unaffected.

lia: prepping a short customer note template in #support. will hold until we have mitigation plan.

jessica: mitigation plan proposal: 1) apply WAF block for header-hash=0x8f3a + geofence to known bad ASNs; 2) dynamic quota cut for untrusted API keys to 0.5 RPS for 30m; 3) disable embeddings-async-batch endpoint for public tier (route: /v1/embeddings/async) as temporary stopgap; 4) enable tarpit on high-fanout IPs.

ops-bot: Automations: created incident-1767894321, notified oncall rotation.

sam: agree. roll those in. jessica, can you paste the exact WAF rule and the cli to apply?

jessica: applying now. command:
```
redwood-cli waf create-rule --name "block-cred-noise-0x8f3a" --match "header.hash==0x8f3a OR asn IN (12345,67890)" --action block --ttl 3600
```
I'll scope to EU-first then expand.

jessica: also running quick script to mark suspicious API keys as limited:
```
for key in $(redwood-admin list-keys --filter "recent_failures>50") ; do redwood-admin quota set $key rps=0.5 duration=30m; done
```

security: we'll need a revocation list for keys we flag; add them to the incident artifact tracker.

support-pb: lia, tag the customers: cust-314, cust-827, cust-992 — partial impact on embedding ingestion. We should notify them now that we're mitigating and might have brief degraded throughput.

lia: drafting message: "We've detected a spike in bad credential attempts affecting embeddings ingestion for a small set of customers. We're applying targeted mitigations (WAF blocks, reduced quotas) to contain traffic. You may see temporary delays for async batch jobs. We'll update in 20 minutes"

sam: jessica, confirm when WAF rule is live and when quotas are set. add any IPs we should tarpit.

jessica: WAF rule applied to eu-west region at +30s. initial effect: 60% drop in 429s from those IPs. now setting quotas... quota script done — ~180 keys rate-limited.

ops-bot: metric update: embeddings 429 rate down 58% in eu-west, overall ingestion latency back to baseline for most customers.

sam: good. enable tarpit on top 25 IPs from the event. command:
```
netctrl tarpit add --ips $(cat suspicious_ips_top25.txt) --duration 2h --reason "credential-noise-1767894321"
```

jessica: tarpit in place. monitoring.

support-pb: lia posted customer note to the three impacted accounts. added recommended workaround: retry with backoff and smaller batch sizes.

lia: customers acked, appreciate the quick heads-up :thumbsup:.

security: we've pulled sample payloads and are starting a forensics run. looks like automated credential-farm, not targeted credential stuffing of specific customers.

sam: next actions: keep quotas for 30m, keep WAF rule for 1h and re-evaluate; keep embeddings-async disabled until load stable; support to continue customer comms; postmortem owner: jessica.

jessica: will own postmortem and include the detection signatures + recommendations: - tighten header fingerprint heuristics - add ephemeral challenge on high-fanout sessions - automatic key freeze after X failures + human review.

ops-bot: scheduled follow-up check in 30m. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

sam: thanks team. if anything regresses, page immediately. otherwise we'll reconvene for the postmortem notes in #incidents-docs. :white_check_mark:
